playbook.note: grace/PLAYBOOK.md read this job; list the rules applied (house rules, structure, CTA, hooks, pacing)

coach_research.note: tiktok-shop-coach output files: discover/tag/shop on the product keyword AND `video` on the top 3 shop videos

viral_board.note: tiktok.py viral output (viral-<date>.json) for the product's category, from this job

product_facts.note: file with every claim and its source (listing, box, brand site)

hooks.note: file with 3 hook options per video: spoken line AND on-screen text, each modeled on a named winner

humanizer.note: Humanizer report on the FINAL script + captions (tells found, what changed)

readability.note: tiktok.py readability output for each script (grade must be <= 6)

line_sources.note: file showing the source of every script line (coach data / playbook / psychology / research)

compare.note: tiktok.py compare <top winner> <our cut> output, after the final cut, and what was fixed
